reviews.title: Well made
reviews.review_text: If you are unfamiliar with power tools, the instructions included with this drill don't tell you how to use the drill. There are operating instructions for an electric wrench, electric grinder, electric hammer, a cutting machine, a hairdryer, a chainsaw and a reciprocating saw. But the directions for the drill, nonexistent. So, I haven't used it yet, because I have to get someone to explain it to me first. But it seems sturdy and it seems well-made and it has come with all its pieces and parts.

reviews.title: Nice looking drill
reviews.review_text: Just opened my package today, thought I would charge it up so I can use it soon, but I am unable to use it soon because I didn't realize I had to buy a battery charger the battery, I thought everything was in the box was all I needed. Now I need to shop for a battery charger to charge the battery to be able to use the drill. If I had known, I would have bought a battery charger the same day I bought the drill. I hope the charger I buy doesn't need additional components to be able to work and hope it works with the drill I bought. It's a little frustrating, I have to buy something to be able to get the drill to work.
This drill doesn't have the ability to hold the drill bit. It still works as long as you keep reinserting the bit
Seems to work well but it was supposed to come with a pink carry bag, and it came with a black one that didn't look like the quality of the pink one
i might just be dumb but none of the pieces fit into the hole/stay snugly ? super cute though
